author: The Current
description:
Anna Graves talks about returning to Minnesota after time living in Los Angeles and in Nashville
Support The Current: https://support.mpr.org/youtube or hit the Thanks button

“I think that I had, for a lot of time in my 20s, thought that happiness was always a milestone away.” So says Minnesota singer-songwriter Anna Graves, who had spent some years living in Los Angeles and in Nashville pursuing her career in music. In 2023, Graves returned to her home state of Minnesota, and this Thursday, Sept. 24, she’ll play her first-ever sold-out headlining show when she takes the stage at the Turf Club in St. Paul.

Watch more of what Graves has to say about her return to Minnesota in her interview with The Current's Zach McCormick in the video above.

author: The Current
description:
Watch Humbird perform "All Water" live in an Eau Claire coffeehouse
Support The Current: https://support.mpr.org/youtube or hit the Thanks button

When the Eaux Claires Festival returned in the summer of 2026, The Current and Radio Milwaukee teamed up for a live broadcast from Shift Coffee Bar in Eau Claire, Wisconsin. On Thursday, July 23, singer-songwriter Siri Undlin — who heads the music project Humbird — performed a set of three songs from her forthcoming album, "Morning When It Comes," releasing Friday, Sept. 25.

Watch a performance of "All Water" above.
